## Walkthrough

The manuscript is modularized and its claims are scoped. Lean now proves the connected bipartite double-cover counting identity constructively. Python and C++ tools add exact rho certification, deterministic sweep orchestration, tests, and reproducible build workflows.

The abstract and manuscript text distinguish proved, exact, bounded, unresolved, and numerical results.|

<details>
<summary>🧹 Nitpick comments (2)</summary><blockquote>

<details>
<summary>Makefile (2)</summary><blockquote>

`2-8`: _🎯 Functional Correctness_ | _🔵 Trivial_ | _⚡ Quick win_

**Capture Git-derived metadata once per Make invocation.**

These recursive assignments re-run `$(shell ...)` every time the variables are expanded. A checkout changing during the recipe could therefore mix commit/date values and undermine deterministic metadata. Use one-time `:=` assignments while preserving command-line overrides. GNU Make documents that shell functions in recursively expanded variables execute repeatedly. ([gnu.org](https://www.gnu.org/software/make/manual/html_node/Shell-Function.html?utm_source=openai))

<details>
<summary>Proposed fix</summary>

```diff
-GIT_COMMIT ?= $(shell git rev-parse --short=12 HEAD)
-SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH ?= $(shell git show -s --format=%ct HEAD)
-DATE ?= $(shell perl -MPOSIX=strftime -e 'print strftime("%F", gmtime(shift))' $(SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH))
-PDF_DATE ?= $(shell perl -MPOSIX=strftime -e 'print strftime("%Y:%m:%d %H:%M:%S", gmtime(shift))' $(SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH))
+ifndef GIT_COMMIT
+GIT_COMMIT := $(shell git rev-parse --short=12 HEAD)
+endif
+ifndef SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH
+SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH := $(shell git show -s --format=%ct HEAD)
+endif
+ifndef DATE
+DATE := $(shell perl -MPOSIX=strftime -e 'print strftime("%F", gmtime(shift))' $(SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH))
+endif
+ifndef PDF_DATE
+PDF_DATE := $(shell perl -MPOSIX=strftime -e 'print strftime("%Y:%m:%d %H:%M:%S", gmtime(shift))' $(SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH))
+endif
```
</details>

<details>
<summary>🤖 Prompt for AI Agents</summary>

```
Verify each finding against current code. Fix only still-valid issues, skip the
rest with a brief reason, keep changes minimal, and validate.

In `@Makefile` around lines 2 - 8, Change the Git-derived metadata assignments
GIT_COMMIT, SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH, and DATE from recursive (?=) to simple (:=)
assignments so each shell command runs once per Make invocation, while retaining
command-line override behavior. Update PDF_DATE, PDF_TITLE, PDF_SUBJECT, and
PDF_KEYWORDS consistently where their values depend on the captured metadata.
```

</details>
